title: Circular waste valorization: humic acid adsorption onto ZnS nanoparticle-loaded biomass and conversion into nutrient-rich alginate beads
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22879-22896
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00928J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
J. Balaji, R. Lakshmipathy
This study aims to investigate the adsorption of humic acid onto zinc sulphide (ZnS) nanoparticle-loaded acid-activated biomass (ZnS-AAB) and its conversion to alginate beads with the addition of K+ and NO32− for agricultural applications.
